timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, I am Amita. I am the product and marketing manager of Ominatecnologies. Ominatecnologies
focuses on ethical and trustworthy artificial intelligence.
What is your AI solution? The solution is called Connect Insights to Actions. We have
successfully implemented it in the life sciences to support sales and marketing managers
into taking the appropriate actions to prevent brand switching. We identify the doctors that
are likely to switch brands, why they are switching brands and what is the additional impact
of making an additional sales call to those doctors.
How does your AI solution work? The solution consists out of three steps. First, we apply
an interpretable method such as GATM and combine it with Shapri-Editiff explanations.
We compare the accuracy of the former with a more black box mod method such as random forests.
If the accuracy of the random forest method is much better, we keep that and also augmented
with the Shapri-Editiff explanations to provide explainable insights. Finally, we translate
the Shapri-Editiff explanations into marginal effects. That gives you insights into what
is the impact of making an additional sales call to a doctor to prevent a doctor from switching
brands. In which sectors can you apply it?
The solution has been successfully implemented in the life sciences. However, you can implement
it in any sector where explanations can help you guide you to better appropriate actions,
such as financial services industry, insurances, health care or public sector.
Which technologies were used to develop it?
The technologies that were used were Founders, Python, S.K. Learn and Docker.
What is the level of complexity and number of days needed to develop it?
We estimate the level of complexity to be intermediate due to the need of customization.
In project mode, we estimate 250 mandates. In production mode, we estimate 350 days so
that we can actually set up an AI pipeline.
What is the business value and ROI of your AI product?
The solution connects insights to actions, provides actionable insights to marketing and
sales management towards which doctors are most likely to switch brands. Why and which
actions to take to mitigate brand switching?
Sales management can tell their sales efforts towards particular segments, whereas marketing
management can change the copy towards particular segments.
Which skills do you need to develop it?
You may need coding skills to develop it. Your team should consist of a data architect,
data scientist, data engineer, a business translator and a project manager.
And learn more about your AI product.
The solution connect insights to action is available right now. You can apply to brand switching
use case, but you can also apply to any use case where explanations can guide you to the
appropriate action.
For example, in early disease diagnosis, you want to predict who is most likely to have
disease, but also you want to tell your actions accordingly.
Why is it essential for companies to implement AI now?
With AI, you can improve your business decision making. However, BlackVox models do not provide
you with explanations of why they make a certain decision. So they hamper the adoption of AI
solutions. So if you want to improve your business decisions, you have to adopt explainable
AI solutions such as connect insights to actions.
And this will guide you to the appropriate actions with rest.

youtube_description:
The Brussels' AI week starts on  March 16th  2020 at DigitYser!

Here is Anita Prinzie of Omina Technologies talking about the AI solution they will present during that week.

Join us and benefit from the experience of the entire AI Ecosystem.
You can choose the topics you want to attend on startai.be 
- AI discovery Tour
- Lots of customer cases: Belfius, Ageas, SPF, UCB, Telenet, DPG ...
- Hands-On AI workshop on AWS
- AI maturity workshop with Sagacify
- AI in the Media Industry with DPG, Medialaan, Telenet, VRT ...
- AI4Belgium annual lunch event
- 6th anniversary of the Data Science community of Belgium

See you all soon at the Brussels' AI week
Registrations on: startai.be

Camera & editing: Mufit Y. Gokmen

*

DigitYser is the digital flagship of Brussels, where communities gather to learn, teach and create digital solutions focused on Data, Artificial Intelligence , the Internet of Things, Blockchain, and Virtual Reality. 

This channel is all about learning about these topics. We film and publish most of our meetups, conferences and bootcamps.
